column1: # STALE-OUTSIDE-LIST files a person has ruled may wait, each for at most 30 days.
# DEST<TAB>NOT_AFTER<TAB>HELD_ON<TAB>REASON, LF only. Read from main by
# `scripts/ktp-ci-install --check`; it changes what the outside-list job REPORTS and
#   NOT_AFTER  the hold stops counting ON this date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the job fails again
#   HELD_ON    the day the row was added; NOT_AFTER - HELD_ON may not exceed 30 days
#   REASON     the ruling, so the next reader knows who decided and why
# A row that does not parse, or holds for longer, fails the job. A hold on a file that
# is no longer stale prints a NOTE: delete the row once its install has happened.
